approval_ref: The active goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content under ponytail reuse constraints.
notes: Autodesk and Procore document Official Response as a distinct RFI field, but the current exact role parser recognizes only Response, Answer and Reply.
Reuse the existing heading-boundary regular expression and workflow index; do not add a vendor status engine or dependency.
Official Response Date and Suggested Answer are not official-response headings and must remain neutral.
612 Python tests, 24 UI JavaScript tests, 11 deployment-boundary tests, specification sync and the 339-file manifest passed offline; no customer document, credential or provider call was used.
title: Recognize explicit RFI Official Response headings
objective: Treat an exact Official Response heading as an RFI response across local text/email parsing and the existing reviewer workflow without matching similar metadata or draft-answer fields.
